description: Seed dataset for the product category classifier. Text from the 28 photographs of 10 retail packages in the project's own frozen extraction-evaluation set (our-eval-v0.1-draft; the photographs are not in the repository, their SHA-256 digests are recorded per example), plus five model-drafted transcriptions of the most legible declaration panels. OCR text is verbatim output of the registered tesseract pipeline at the recorded version, regenerated on 2026-09-16 with `python -m labelextract.cli <image> --pipeline tesseract --pipeline-version 0.3.0`. Category labels were assigned by a model from the photographs and annotation notes and are NOT human-verified; every example says so in label_verified_by. Ten products is far too few to train a general classifier or to quote a meaningful accuracy: three of the four subcategories present are represented by a single product each. This set exists to establish the format, the provenance discipline and the training pipeline, and to give the regression tests real label text. See docs/ml/product-classification.md.

examples.note: ShineXPro Helmet Cleaner: a 120 g aerosol foam cleaner for motorcycle helmets. Declaration block framed and in focus; the reference reading for this product.

examples.text:
ShineXPro Helmet Cleaner, your go-to solution for hygiene and freshness in your helmet. Our advanced foaming formula effortlessly penetrates helmet interiors and sponge surfaces, effectively removing dirt and grime to restore a pristine appearance. Infused with antimicrobial additive, it neutralises odour-causing bacteria ensuring long-term hygiene. Enjoy a refreshing fragrance that lingers after each use, while our gentle formula remains safe for all helmet materials like the exterior, fabric and sponge. It has been lab tested to be safe for both skin & hair. The convenient spray nozzle allows for effortless application, while our eco-friendly, biodegradable formulation minimises environmental impact.
DIRECTIONS:
Shake the bottle well, keep it upright and spray on the entire helmet interior surface from a distance of 6-8 inches. Allow the foam to soak for a while. Use a clean microfiber cloth to scrub and work the cleaner into the surface. Wipe off the excess. Repeat the same for the helmet exterior. Avoid spraying on the visor. In case there is an overspray on the visor, simply wipe it off. Allow to air dry before using it again.
WARNING:
Extremely flammable aerosol. Pressurised container, may burst if heated. Causes serious eye irritation. Keep away from heat. Do not pierce or burn, even after use. Do not expose to temperatures exceeding 50°C. Keep out of reach of children. Use outdoors or in a well-ventilated area.
